name: capline-mcp

tools.name: create_mandate
tools.description: Provision a spend mandate: a per-transaction cap, a cumulative cap enforced across every chain, and an optional payee allowlist. Returns a mandateId to pass to `pay`. This is a PRINCIPAL action. DEMO MODE: no mandate is pinned, so the agent can also create its own mandate; this is not a security boundary. Pin one with CAPLINE_MANDATE_ID for real use.

maxTotal.description: cumulative ceiling in USDC, across every chain combined

chains.description: chains this mandate is provisioned on

allowedPayees.description: allowed payee identities; empty = any payee

tools.name: pay
tools.description: Request a payment on behalf of the agent. It is checked against the mandate and REFUSED if it exceeds the per-transaction cap, the payee is not on the allowlist, or it would breach the cross-chain cap. Approved payments are authorized and recorded on the Capline coordinator ledger; this tool does not itself move funds on-chain. DEMO MODE: no mandate is pinned, so the agent can also create its own mandate; this is not a security boundary. Pin one with CAPLINE_MANDATE_ID for real use.

mandateId.description: the mandate to spend under (from create_mandate)

tools.name: mandate_status
tools.description: Read a mandate's current state: committed spend, reserved, remaining budget, and the per-chain breakdown.

tools.name: revoke_mandate
tools.description: Revoke a mandate. After this the coordinator refuses every payment under it. (On-chain mandates must also be revoked on each chain by the principal.) This is a PRINCIPAL action. DEMO MODE: no mandate is pinned, so the agent can also create its own mandate; this is not a security boundary. Pin one with CAPLINE_MANDATE_ID for real use.
